question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Modest
solution: The correct answer is '**Conceited**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Modest**' is '**Conceited**'. • **Modest**: not talking too much about your own abilities, good qualities, etc. [विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला)] • *Example: She got the best results in the exam but she was too **modest** to tell anyone.* • **Conceited**: excessively proud of oneself; vain. (अहंकारी, घमंडी) • *Example: He’s so **conceited**—he thinks he’s the best at everything!* **Correct Answer:__** *Conceited.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Unhappy**: sad. (दुखी, खिन्‍न या उदास, दुखभरा, दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण) • **Sullen**: looking bad-tempered and not wanting to speak to people. [चिड़चिड़ा और उदासी भरा (लोगों से बोलने का अनिच्‍छुक); खिन्‍न] • **Glum**: sad and quiet. (उदास और चुपचाप) 3f:T593, The correct answer is** 'Say two contradictory things at the same time'.**
